# Volume 4 timeline

## CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Small Anne Cordelia](../character/small-anne-cordelia.md)** — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Wright](../character/diana-barry.md) talk in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret while [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) holds her young child. They discuss [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishing her teaching career, her upcoming marriage to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their plans to live at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016)_

## CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss wedding gifts and prepare for Anne's upcoming marriage. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives well-wishing visitors with mixed comments, after which [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives and tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about the house he has found for their future home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P4](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P15](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0015)_

## CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her wedding guest list and plans with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Friends and guests, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) ahead of the ceremony, bringing news and gifts like Miss Patty's china dogs. On the eve of her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Matthew's grave and walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), reminiscing about their past together.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P60](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0060)_

## CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), Allans, [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Small Anne Cordelia](../character/small-anne-cordelia.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her time in her childhood room. Friends and family gather for the wedding ceremony in the orchard, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart on the train for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P17](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0017)_

## CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drive through [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) toward their new house, taking in the picturesque scenery and passing a remarkably beautiful local girl driving geese. Upon reaching the house, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the threshold into their new home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P1](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P17](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P19](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), Mrs. Doctor Dave, and Captain Jim welcome [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). The group enjoys supper together while Captain Jim and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) share stories and details about the surrounding community and neighbors.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P7](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P31](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Captain Jim tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) the romantic history of the schoolmaster [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) and his bride [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md), who lived in their house sixty years ago. He recounts Selwyn's prophetic vision of his bride's arrival after her ship was months overdue. Before taking his leave, Captain Jim welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the select group of 'kindred spirits' who belong to 'the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).'

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P34](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Captain Jim bond over [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Bryant's concept of 'the race that knows Joseph', or kindred spirits. As their visitors depart into the moonlit night, Captain Jim shares stories about trimming Miss Elizabeth's Lombardies and his lifelong love of the moon. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stroll through their garden, taking in the peaceful surroundings of their new home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P56](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P60](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0060), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P64](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0064)_

## CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reflect on their perfect honeymoon month at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and Gilbert's recent medical success. Later, Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) visits them to sew clothes for a needy family while sharing her outspoken opinions on marriage, religion, and the local townspeople.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — Miss Cornelia shares her sharp opinions on men, the local minister, and mutual acquaintances while visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Before concluding her visit, Miss Cornelia agrees to stay for tea and reveals she knows [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been listening and laughing from his office.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P59](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0059), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P74](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0074), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P79](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0079)_

## CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk down to the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse to visit Captain Jim. Along the way, they pass the unusually hairy [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), and upon arriving, Captain Jim warmly welcomes them, shows them the lighthouse, and entertains them with local stories and tea.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P7](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Captain Jim tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) about how he saved the First Mate and shares stories from his adventurous past while showing them his collection of curiosities. After Captain Jim expresses his longing for the sea and misses his late friend [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) promise to visit often before walking home and discussing his character.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P51](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057)_

## CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — While walking and dancing along the shore after a storm, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is surprised to meet her mysterious neighbor, [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). The two introduce themselves, discuss their lives and mutual acquaintance Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), and agree to become friends despite Leslie's reserved and troubled demeanor. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home and shares her impressions of [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P4](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058)_

## CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and recounts the tragic life history of [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), including her family misfortunes, forced marriage, and caring for her brain-damaged husband [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — Miss Cornelia encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to be a persistent friend to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) despite her reserved nature and difficult domestic life with [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). Touched by Leslie's tragic situation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to do everything she can to win Leslie's friendship.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P39](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P41](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)_

## CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the house of dreams for a pleasant evening of firelight conversation and books. As she leaves, the contrast between their happy life and her own bitterness momentarily saddens her. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) lovingly discuss Leslie's beauty and Anne's hair color.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P0](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P13](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P18](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0018)_

## CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — On a foggy evening while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is away, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) Moore's house for company. Looking in, she sees [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping bitterly in secret and decides not to disturb her, retreating outside where she meets Captain Jim bringing [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) home. Captain Jim then walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to her house while they discuss [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P19](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend autumn evenings visiting Captain Jim at the lighthouse. Walking home together afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss Leslie's wasted potential before affectionately reaffirming their own love and home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P4](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P13](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0013)_

## CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming guests including [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. While dinner is prepared and served, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia engage in a lively debate to Gilbert's amusement. After a successful meal carved by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), the party gathers by the hearth as Captain Jim shares stories before taking his leave.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P4](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

## CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) head to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) to watch the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) come in at the lighthouse with Captain Jim and [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md). After Captain Jim shares stories about his sleeping nephew Joe and plays his fiddle, Marshall and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) dance around the fire. At midnight, Captain Jim opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) and wishes everyone well.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

## CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her lingering sense of a barrier and quiet resentment between herself and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with Captain Jim. Later, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares news of her expected child, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) acts bitterly at first but eventually gives her a exquisitely handcrafted white baby dress. Inspired after reading Captain Jim's personal life-book, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wishes someone with the right literary gift could write his life story.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P3](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P21](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0021)_

## CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Daniel](../character/daniel.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bring her quahog shells for her garden and sweet-grass, sharing memories and thoughts on nature. Later, Captain Jim, Miss Cornelia, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) gather at the house to discuss local news, religion, and neighbors, which ends in Captain Jim and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stepping outside to laugh at the women's commentary.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P6](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P57](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0057)_

## CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she gives birth to a newborn girl named Joyce, but the baby tragically passes away later that evening. Friends and family offer comfort and prepare the baby for burial, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grieves deeply and struggles to find meaning or comfort in her sorrow.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P32](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0032)_

## CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a drive to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) and leaves her with Captain Jim. Captain Jim comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her grief over losing her baby by telling her the story of his lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and asking [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to keep her memory alive.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P1](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P8](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P19](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she used to feel intense envy and hatred toward her because of Anne's happiness and home life, especially while trapped in her own difficult situation with [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) listens sympathetically and reassures her, leading the two women to reconcile their past feelings and pledge a deep, lasting friendship.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) insists that [Susan](../character/susan.md) remain as household help so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can rest. Later, Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia visit, chatting over pie about neighborhood news, including [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) agreeing to take in a summer boarder named [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md).

## CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md)** — [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) drops off [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) at Anne's house so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can guide him to Leslie's, where he will be boarding. While walking him over, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Owen chat about the area's history and his hopes of finding inspiration for a novel. Upon arriving, Owen is struck by Leslie's beauty and meets the Moore household.

## CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visit Captain Jim at [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point), where Captain Jim realizes Owen is the grandson of the schoolmaster's bride from his past. Captain Jim entertains his guests with numerous sea tales and lends Owen his treasured life-book to read. On the walk home, Owen marvels at the captain's extraordinary life while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assures him the stories are true.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P37](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0037)_

## CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) eagerly agrees to turn Captain Jim's life-book into a novel, incorporating the story of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). Throughout a wonderful summer at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), Owen works on the manuscript with input from Captain Jim, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), forming close bonds with the group before completing his draft.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P11](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018)_

## CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md)** — In the garden, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he is deeply in love with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) and agonizes over having to leave her behind in her miserable life. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sympathizes with his grief while agreeing that he must go away silently. Miss Cornelia interrupts their quiet moment with a blunt remark, lightening the tense mood before Owen leaves.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P13](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)_

## CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the channel and encounters [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) walking on the foggy sand shore. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) tearfully confesses her love for [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), feeling ashamed and brokenhearted over his departure. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her while keeping Owen's secret, and she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) bring [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) back home with them.

## CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to chat about newspaper obituaries, past town memories, and Leslie's feelings for [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), joined briefly by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Later, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) grieves over the death of her old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After returning from a New Year's visit to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are welcomed home by Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia, who shares news about Owen Ford's book.

## CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he believes [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) Moore's memory and mental faculties could be restored through a surgical operation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strongly opposes the idea, arguing that it would worsen Leslie's suffering and burden her financially. Despite Anne's protests and opposing advice from [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) maintains that it is his duty as a physician to inform [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) of the possibility.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P10](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P12](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P15](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P47](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0047)_

## CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) consult Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must be informed about the medical possibility for [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tells [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who decides to take [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the operation despite the emotional toll. Later, Miss Cornelia angrily confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over the decision, but eventually accepts that nothing can stop the plan.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P30](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P48](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0048)_

## CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md), [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) prepares for Dick's surgery in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Gilbert's assistance, securing financial help through a mortgage from Captain Jim. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) returns home to find [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in shock over a letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). The letter reveals that the man believed to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) is actually his lookalike cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) died years ago.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P16](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), utterly shocked by the news that the man believed to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), freeing [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) from her marriage. They discuss how George and [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) looked so much alike, how everyone was deceived, and Miss Cornelia urges [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to let [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) know about Leslie's freedom.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P0](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P20](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0020)_

## CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) returns home alone and visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her garden. She recounts how [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) was reunited with his sister after regaining his memory and explains her complex feelings of shock and loneliness. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) also reflects on her past torment over deciding whether to allow the operation.

## CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name James Matthew after Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia visit to admire the child and celebrate his arrival. Later, Miss Cornelia tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) plans to return for a visit, and they discuss Leslie's future plans.

## CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md)** — In the wake of the general election, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share news of the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits the lighthouse, where she encounters a newly clean-shaven [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall-elliott.md). **[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love for [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she eagerly confesses her love in return. ## CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) deliver the long-awaited printed copy of his life story to Captain Jim, who hosts them for tea and celebrates the occasion. The next morning, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) notices that the lighthouse light is still burning past sunrise and goes with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to investigate. They discover Captain Jim lying peacefully on his sofa, having passed away overnight while reading the final pages of his book.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P4](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P11](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P16](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Jem](../character/jem.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes buying the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), which distresses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at first due to her deep love for their little house of dreams. [Susan](../character/susan.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) discuss the upcoming move with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shares the comforting news that Owen plans to buy their current house as a summer home. Eventually, the moving day arrives, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully says a final goodbye to her beloved house before leaving with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P21](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P65](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0065)_
